messages.content: Act as a sceptical benchmark researcher and product designer. Advise a new PALO BlueprintBench leaderboard inspired by Arena's category navigation, dense tables, comparisons and visual polish. Do not browse or invent results. We need a stronger evidence interface, NOT a claim of superior measurement. Current data: (A) three API baselines GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, synthetic procurement, one maintainer-authored family, 36 source rules, 108 seeded statements, 3 repetitions, 54 assigned calls, 53 complete, 1 Google HTTP503. Verification agreement with assistant-draft labels: 324/324 OpenAI,322/324 Claude,288/324 Gemini (36 missing). Claude's two disagreements are the same contested item: increased overseas tolerance versus a universal EUR10 threshold; label not_established may be wrong. Frozen primary counts remain; explicit posthoc exclusion for all models yields321/321,321/321,285/321. All observed disagreements disappear on the uncontested subset, so no model quality ranking justified. 27 source-indexed translation outputs, 324 rules, reviewed by engineering assistant, many verbatim copies. Posthoc draft-evaluator replay exports27draft blueprints, not appE2E; no human validation. Costs0.1033389,0.361496,0.365732USD plus1unknown forGemini with0.3821642reserved. Allreasoninghigh, pinnedproviders, nofallback,32768totaloutput, defaulttemps/no seed. (B) historical10challenger configs on3passages4994bytes, differingreasoning/quantization, no repetitions, structural acceptance only, all43relations failed; never pool with(A). Independentgold,custodian,annotators,measurevalidation allmissing;qualified=falseeverywhere. We must retain failed/missing denominators, distinguish unknowncost fromzero, configuredlimit vsusedcontext, model vsprovider vsadapter, raw evidence and benchmark revision. Naming leaderboard permissible only with empty qualifiedrank layer and clearlylabelledinternal evidence. Englishpublication. Please give concise actionable advice (~1000words): 1) best information architecture and visual hierarchy;2) six genuinely useful advanced interactions supported by these data;3) misleading UI choices to forbid;4) robust JSON-LD choice CollectionPage/Dataset/ItemList and howto avoid fake ratings/ranks/certification;5) acceptance tests;6) critical design flaws you see in ourplan. Do not describe yourself as independent humanreviewer or add yourself to benchmarkcohort. Your response is advisorydesignconsultation.
